name: INSERT COIN
author: swtdr34mz (based on Blop by Obsimo)
tagline: Chiptune chords and melody with an 80s arcade shooter
description: A chiptune chord player with an 80s arcade shooter that plays along. The black keys play the chords of 10 game-style levels, each with its own sound, rhythm and scale; the white keys play a melody that always fits the chord. Every key fires your ship: play on the beat for a combo. Sound effects in key and time, HURRY UP waves, boss waves that raise the key, an 8-BIT mode and an attract mode. Chip sounds, Game Boy style drums, a drum studio with 20 user slots, an 8-bar chord looper, bitcrusher. Chords and bass out over USB MIDI.
credits: Built on fm1-base (Charles Vestal) and felucca-bsp (Leo Kuroshita, Hügelton Instruments); title type Press Start 2P (CodeMan38, SIL OFL 1.1).
